news.headline: Float launchpad accused of 'vamping' existing Solana memecoins
news.detail: X News story (updated 00:12 Berlin): Float, a Solana launchpad launched in late October that promised to stop copycat 'vamp' launches, is accused of its users doing exactly that to coins like $DOPE (a Doge-Pepe hybrid). The summary says the drama has pushed $FLOAT down from its peaks. Solana trader Unipcs ('Bonk Guy') also vented about trading backlash in a related trending thread. AI-generated summary; no prices given.

news.headline: Traders call for a return of 'bagworking' as memecoin market cools
news.detail: X's news summary (updated 20:56 Berlin) says traders are nostalgic for 'bagworking', holding and promoting a single memecoin like a full-time job, as in early Solana days, with posts like 'We need to make bag working great again'. It says new tokens such as $BAGWORK aim to revive the idea, while some doubt it can return amid fast flips. No price or market-cap figures were given.

news.headline: Warren set to chair Senate Banking, with Trump-family crypto and prediction markets as first targets
news.coins: Trump-family crypto ventures (incl. the $TRUMP meme coin ecosystem); prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi
news.detail: X's news summary (updated 21:36 Berlin) says Elizabeth Warren, as the incoming Banking Committee chair, plans to go after a 'Wild West-style lack of oversight' in prediction markets. It also says she is warning Trump-family crypto businesses, reportedly earning at least $2.3B, to keep their documents, and that hearings with subpoena power could start in January. It surfaced in the sweep via a @Morosaki headline at 21:33 Berlin.

The probes cover alleged Iran- and Russia-linked transactions at Binance and Tether and ethics questions around Trump-family crypto projects. He has no subpoena power until the new Congress meets, and no wrongdoing has been found. Low engagement at scan (0 likes, 14 impressions).

news.headline: Pieverse token reportedly up 500% since Fourtis listing (MC ~$63M → ~$383.3M)
news.detail: @fourtislisting (67,336 followers) posted at 20:00 Berlin a Pump Alert that the Pieverse token is up 500% since listing on Fourtis, citing first MC $63M and last MC $383.3M. Fourtis is the listing service's own promo account; no contract address in the post. About 7,418 impressions and 4 likes at scan.

news.headline: X News: Pump.fun traders question the 'check top holders' strategy
news.detail: X News story says Pump.fun's head of content claims checking top holders gives better insight than other apps thanks to its social graph, while traders push back with examples of losses after following prominent wallets or KOL calls such as Ansem's. The story says 95% of the platform's revenue comes from coins under $250K market cap, amid concerns about fake volume on migrated tokens.

news.headline: @alexxxx: Pump.fun stops callout rewards for Slingoor
news.detail: @alexxxx (12,960 followers) posted at 19:40 Berlin that Pump.fun has taken action and stopped callout rewards for Slingoor, the Solana influencer accused of dumping his Big Titty Coin stake (see the X News item below). Single post; no Pump.fun statement seen in the sources yet.

news.headline: X News: Elysium mainnet launches for the Hyperliquid ecosystem
news.detail: X News story (updated 19:39 Berlin) says Kinetiq launched the Elysium Layer 2 mainnet on 9 Nov (chain ID 99901, HYPE as gas, an Arbitrum Orbit chain settling to HyperEVM), with a perps-backed launchpad and 50% of sequencer fees funding KNTQ buybacks and burns. Memecoin launches on Elysium are already showing up in the X feed, alongside rug accusations against some Elysium launchpads.

news.headline: Pump.fun reportedly sunsetting web3 wallet login in about 20 days
news.detail: @Crypto_Retardio (4,157 followers) posted at 19:33 Berlin that users who imported a wallet into the Pump.fun app have 20 more days to add a social login before web3 login is sunsetted; the same post says the Pump.fun app can be used to trade on Elysium. Single post, not yet confirmed by Pump.fun in the sources seen.

news.headline: @raid100x teases launching 'the BIGGEST memecoin of 2026'
news.detail: @raid100x (907,767 followers) posted at 19:07 Berlin: 'I am launching the BIGGEST memecoin of 2026. Are you in?' No name, chain, or date given. Early engagement was modest (4 likes, 2 replies, about 1,064 impressions at scan time). Big-account teasers like this often draw copycat contracts, so treat any CA claiming to be it with caution.

news.headline: @gumsays: Percolator and Big Titty Coin holders down $1.8M in 24 hours
news.detail: @gumsays (67,623 followers) posted at 19:00 Berlin that holders of the two Solana memecoins lost about $1.8M in 24 hours after the Percolator team 'rugged' (moving to a new token) and a top Big Titty Coin holder sold. The post says three wallets alone are down about half a million dollars on PERCOLATOR. Follow-up to the two X News stories already listed below; figures come from that post.

news.headline: $TRUMP reportedly hits a new all-time low near $1.12
news.detail: @Millon_Sancet (3,201 followers) posted at 18:53 Berlin that $TRUMP is around $1.12, about 1.5% of its $73.43 all-time high and down 31% this week. Figures come from that single post and weren't independently confirmed; low engagement so far.

news.headline: X News: 'I am NOT a Chinese spy' meme spreads through crypto circles
news.detail: X News story (updated ~17:16 Berlin) says crypto journalist Tiffany Fong started it on 9 Nov with a selfie captioned 'I am NOT a Chinese spy', drawing thousands of likes; influencer Irene Zhao and others joined with variants ('NOT a CIA spy'). It riffs on recent OpenAI warnings about romance 'honeypot' spies. Fresh crypto-native meme that could spawn coins; none reported in the sources so far.

news.headline: Bubblemaps alleges Solana trader Cupsey dumped on followers via ~30 hidden wallets
news.detail: @AlphaWireHQ (23,200 followers) reported at 18:06 Berlin that blockchain analytics firm @bubblemaps alleges Cupsey used about 30 hidden wallets to buy memecoins early, promote them publicly and sell into followers' buying, for about $1.74M. Allegation only; post text was cut off. Unrelated to the $cupsey ticker being shilled by call accounts. Follow-up from @CryptoNews_op (5,340 followers, 18:32 Berlin): the alleged wallets have traded over 27,000 times since 7 May (post text cut off).

news.headline: X News: North Korean hackers mint meme coins to launder Binance heist funds
news.detail: X News story says the TraderTraitor group, blamed by the FBI for the 29 Oct Binance hack (reported as a record $6.4B heist), created at least six tokens on NEAR between 5 and 7 Nov and funneled about $430,000 in stolen NEAR through their liquidity pools using separate wallet clusters. Elliptic spotted the tactic; each token cost about $90 to make, and almost no real traders joined in. Story spreading at 18:41 Berlin: @blocknewsdotcom (87,446 followers) posted it; @MarketSignalMK adds that similar activity appeared on Tron and Solana.

news.headline: X News: Solana influencer Slingoor dumps Big Titty Coin stake
news.detail: X News story says Slingoor (about 190,000 followers, a top Pump.fun earner with over $526,000 in rewards) heavily promoted the coin, then his wallet sold 62% of supply in under a minute, taking it from millions to near zero. He cited extortion attempts and death threats and said he had lost money overall through earlier buybacks.

news.headline: X News: PercolatorTrade abandons its pump.fun token for a new $250K raise
news.detail: X News story says PercolatorTrade moved to MetaDAO's Backable platform for a $250,000 raise with a new PERC token, leaving old $PERCOLATOR holders with no migration or airdrop beyond $50,000 reserved for eligible holders; the old token reportedly fell 90%. Critics call it a rug; the team says the old token was a community takeover and the work stays open source.

news.headline: X News: Memecoin debate questions if the era has ended
news.detail: X News story (updated ~07:54 Berlin) summarizes chatter that memecoins may have run their course: fatigue from repeated narratives, launchpads, and mechanics that drain liquidity without lasting value; sector total value cited around $27–31B vs peaks, with Pump.fun seeing far fewer new users/launches than 2025 highs. Some call it the logical end of extraction plays; others hold out for revivals via real community and memes like Pepe.

news.headline: @jussy_world: Ansem (@blknoiz06) shorting SOL and ETH on Pumpfun after "60k 1500 60" post
news.detail: Tracker @jussy_world (76,563 followers) posted at 07:44 Berlin that Ansem is already short on Pumpfun: about $957K of SOL at 20x (entry ~$92.9, +~$29K) and about $501K of ETH at 10x (entry ~$2,221, added overnight), tying it to Ansem's overnight "60k 1500 60" call. Engagement at scan: 1,089 impressions, 5 likes, 1 reply.

news.headline: Paid DEXScreener boost flagged for $notion on Pumpfun Solana
news.detail: Watcher @dex_kolwatcher (8,981 followers) posted at 07:41 Berlin detecting a paid DEXScreener listing for $notion (CA 4C6LMX3q8iwShzW6j6A71NAUCgZ9G72T93hh4bKDpump) on Pumpfun Solana; it cited ~$13.4K buy / ~$11.2K sell volume over 24h, $0 liquidity, and ~$8.2K market cap at scan. Thin engagement on the alert itself (217 impressions, 0 likes).

news.headline: X News: Bubblemaps to expose crypto KOL dumping on followers
news.detail: X News story (updated ~07:35 Berlin) says Bubblemaps will soon unmask a major KOL for luring copy traders with public wallets while dumping via hidden side wallets. Context cites FOMO-style leaderboards and one-tap copy trading, community calls for launchpad audits/bans, and prior exposé teases. Continues Ansem / Pump.fun / KOL drama already on the board; unverified pending reveal from the X News summary.

news.headline: Fluffy (@fluffycrypt) teases Solana memecoin launch today 7PM UTC
news.detail: @fluffycrypt (155,856 followers) posted at 07:32 Berlin a FAQ for an upcoming "FLUFFY MEME COIN" launch: Solana chain, 70% supply detail cut off in post text, timed for today 7PM UTC. Early engagement at scan: about 2,091 impressions, 11 likes, 3 reposts, 10 replies, 1 bookmark. No contract address in the post yet; promotional KOL announce, not a live graduated coin.

news.headline: X News: Robinhood Chain sees memecoins and duck NFTs driving volume
news.detail: X News story (updated ~05:52 Berlin) says Robinhood's Ethereum L2 (launched July 2026 on Arbitrum for tokenized stocks/RWAs) is seeing fresh volume and TVL from memecoins like $ROBINHOOD and NFT projects such as Mallard Order (duck-themed collectibles tied to on-chain stock vaults), with community spaces under StreetHood discussing pumps and tips.

news.headline: X News: Pump.fun launches Diamond rewards to boost bigger token calls
news.detail: X News story (updated ~03:10 Berlin) says Pump.fun is updating Callout Rewards with a Diamond algorithm that increases payouts for calls on higher market-cap tokens, perps, and non-Solana assets while keeping the Degen system; leaderboards split Degen and Diamond, with cited top callout earners in six figures and the platform having disbursed tens of millions total.

news.headline: X News: SPX6900 community sticks with daily memecoin buys
news.detail: X News story (updated ~01:36 Berlin) summarizes SPX6900 holders dollar-cost averaging daily (one cited streak of 502 straight days), with the satirical Ethereum S&P-parody memecoin described around a ~$330M market cap / ~$0.36; community memes like Persist Forever and claims of large holder upside circulate alongside the buys.
